skills.name: Music’s Creation (浴音而生)
skills.line: Music born from my heart, I’m one with my lute.
skills.description: SP Kinnara attacks a single target dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK.

skills.name: Ensemble Formed (与世同奏)
skills.description: Exclusive effect. At the start of battle and at the end of each turn, SP Kinnara awakens her biwa Genjo. ;Genjo (玄象) : :When it is awakened, it will assist the non-summoned ally with the highest initial ATK with 3 additional attacks, with each attack dealing damage equal to 62% of their damage. After attacking it returns to slumber. If no target is specified, it will prioritise an enemy with the lowest HP proportion.

upgrades.text: When Genjo is awakened, increases own Crit RES by 100%, lasts for 2 turns.
When Genjo is awakened, increases own RES by 100%, lasts for 2 turns.
When Genjo is awakened, increases all allies' DEF by 160, lasts for 2 turns.
After Genjo, increases Skill 3 damage by 12% (max of 24%, sustained between rounds).

skills.name: Secular Song (世间之曲)
skills.line: The mortal world with its hustle and bustle will be my new stage.
skills.description: SP Kinnara attacks 1 enemy 6 times, dealing damage equal to 70% of her ATK with each attack. ;Genjo (玄象) : :When it is awakened, it will assist the non-summoned ally with the highest initial ATK with 3 additional attacks, with each attack dealing damage equal to 62% of their damage. After attacking it returns to slumber. If no target is specified, it will prioritise an enemy with the lowest HP proportion.

upgrades.text: When attacking a monster, her own and Genjo's single target damage is increased by 23%.

bio.condition: Team SP Kinnara with another player's Kinnara and clear any zone 10 times.
